title: Plan did not resolve contradiction between settings field and pinned-constant requirement
description: plan_phase_epic stated JWT_ALGORITHM should be 'pinned as constant, not configurable' in Security Considerations and Integration Points, but the Settings stub has JWT_ALGORITHM as a configurable env var field. The plan identified the security requirement but did not specify how to resolve the contradiction (remove from Settings and move to constants.py).
root_cause: plan_phase_epic can identify security requirements but does not cross-reference them against the existing stub implementations to detect contradictions. When a stub field conflicts with a plan requirement, the plan should specify the resolution action.
recommendation: When plan_phase_epic specifies that a value should be a constant (not configurable), it should check if the value exists as a configurable field in Settings or other stubs. If so, the plan should explicitly state: 'Remove X from Settings, define as constant in Y.' This prevents ambiguity during swarm execution.
affected_section: Security Considerations and Technical Strategy generation in plan_phase_epic.md
plan_context: JWT auth with HS256 algorithm, existing Settings stub with configurable JWT_ALGORITHM field
